cn_definition: $\mathcal W$为产品晶圆集合，$w$为产品编号；$\mathcal I$为晶圆路线任务集合，$i$为任务编号，包括产品路线和辅助晶圆每次借用路线。
en_definition: $\mathcal W$: products, indexed by $w$; $\mathcal I$: wafer-route tasks, indexed by $i$, including each product route and each auxiliary-wafer loan route.

cn_definition: $\mathcal S=\{A,V\}$为来源区域集合，$s$为区域索引；$A,V$分别为大气区、真空区。$\sigma=0/1$表示单源/双源；$\chi_{is}=1$表示任务$i$来自区域$s$。
en_definition: $\mathcal S=\{A,V\}$: source regions, indexed by $s$ (atmospheric/vacuum). $\sigma=0/1$: single/dual source. $\chi_{is}=1$: task $i$ originates in region $s$.

cn_definition: $\ell_w$为产品$w$所在LP编号；$m_w\in\{\zeta,\psi\}$为其给定工艺模式；$\mathcal C(m)$为可执行加工类型$m$的腔室集合。
en_definition: $\ell_w$: LP of product $w$; $m_w\in\{\zeta,\psi\}$: its prescribed recipe; $\mathcal C(m)$: chambers compatible with operation type $m$.

cn_definition: 产品晶圆总数，$N=|\mathcal W|=N_{\zeta}+N_{\psi}$，不含辅助晶圆。
en_definition: Number of product wafers, $N=|\mathcal W|=N_\zeta+N_\psi$; excludes auxiliary wafers.

cn_definition: $\mathcal P$为候选PW对集合，$p$为对编号；$\mathcal M=\{\zeta,\psi,\mathrm{cl}\}$为加工类型集合，$m$为类型索引；三种标签依次为$4\times1$、$2\times2$生产和清洁。
en_definition: $\mathcal P$: candidate PW pairs, indexed by $p$; $\mathcal M=\{\zeta,\psi,\mathrm{cl}\}$: operation types, indexed by $m$, denoting $4\times1$ production, $2\times2$ production, and cleaning.

cn_definition: $\mathcal C=\{\mathrm{CH1,CH2}\}$为工艺腔室集合，$c$为腔室编号。
en_definition: $\mathcal C=\{\mathrm{CH1,CH2}\}$: process chambers, indexed by $c$.

cn_definition: $\mathcal Q_c=\{1,\ldots,Q_{\max}\}$为腔室$c$的候选加工周期集合，$q$为周期编号。
en_definition: $\mathcal Q_c=\{1,\ldots,Q_{\max}\}$: candidate chamber cycles in chamber $c$, indexed by $q$.

cn_definition: $N_{\zeta},N_{\psi}$分别为两种工艺的产品数量，下标为工艺标签；$T$为全设备生产周期总数上界；$J_{\max}$为全设备清洁总次数上界。
en_definition: $N_\zeta,N_\psi$: product counts by recipe (recipe-label subscripts). $T$: upper bound on total production cycles; $J_{\max}$: upper bound on total cleanings across the tool.

cn_definition: $P_{\max}$为全批次候选PW对容量；$Q_{\max}$为全设备加工周期总数上界，并用作每腔候选容量；下标$\max$表示上界，加工周期含生产与清洁。
en_definition: $P_{\max}$: candidate-pair capacity for the entire lot. $Q_{\max}$: tool-wide bound on production-plus-cleaning cycles, also used as each chamber\textquotesingle s candidate capacity. The label max denotes an upper bound.

cn_definition: 单腔自初始洁净状态或上次清洁后累计生产周期数的上限；累计1至$H-1$个生产周期后可在合法工艺边界选择清洁，达到$H$时必须清洁。
en_definition: Maximum production count in one chamber since its initially clean state or latest cleaning. Cleaning is optional at a valid boundary after 1 to $H-1$ cycles and mandatory at $H$.

cn_definition: $\mathcal O$为候选物理动作集合，$o,o^{\prime}$为两个动作的编号；$\mathcal A$为动作先后弧集合，$(o,o^{\prime})$表示动作$o$先于$o^{\prime}$。
en_definition: $\mathcal O$: candidate physical actions, indexed by $o,o^{\prime}$; $\mathcal A$: precedence arcs, where $(o,o^{\prime})$ requires $o$ before $o^{\prime}$.

cn_definition: $\mathcal A^{\rm int}$为共同腔内先后弧集合，上标int表示腔内；$\mathcal A_{is}(\gamma)$为任务$i$从区域$s$供回晶圆时、在搬运选择$\gamma$下启用的路线弧集合。
en_definition: $\mathcal A^{\rm int}$: common chamber-internal arcs (int is a label); $\mathcal A_{is}(\gamma)$: supply/return arcs for task $i$ from region $s$, activated by transfer choices $\gamma$.

cn_definition: $d_o$为动作$o$的给定持续时间；$r_c$为腔室$c$半周旋转的给定持续时间，单位均为s。
en_definition: $d_o$: fixed duration of action $o$; $r_c$: half-turn duration of chamber $c$, both in seconds.

cn_definition: $\delta_{oo^{\prime}}$为先后动作$o,o^{\prime}$之间的最小间隔；$\rho^r_{oo^{\prime}}$为资源$r$从$o$转至$o^{\prime}$所需换位或复位时间；$\rho^{\rm VTR}_{cc^{\prime}}$为VTR从腔室$c$至$c^{\prime}$的移动时间。
en_definition: $\delta_{oo^{\prime}}$: minimum precedence gap; $\rho^r_{oo^{\prime}}$: repositioning/reset time on resource $r$ between tasks $o,o^{\prime}$; $\rho^{\rm VTR}_{cc^{\prime}}$: VTR travel time from chamber $c$ to $c^{\prime}$.

cn_definition: $M$为条件时间约束使用的有效大常数；$\overline R_{wr}$为晶圆$w$在受限设备或路线区段$r$内的最大驻留时间，单位为s。
en_definition: $M$: valid large constant for conditional timing constraints; $\overline R_{wr}$: maximum residency of wafer $w$ in constrained equipment or route region $r$, in seconds.

cn_definition: $\overline T$为排程时刻的有效上界；$d_m$为加工类型$m$的固定持续时间，单位为s；上横线表示上界。
en_definition: $\overline T$: valid schedule-time horizon; $d_m$: fixed duration of operation type $m$, in seconds. An overbar denotes an upper bound.

cn_definition: $\mathcal E_c$为腔室$c$的清洁区段集合，$e$为区段编号；$\mathcal V_c$为该腔生产任务集合，$v$为任务编号，任务为一个$4\times1$批次或$2\times2$生产周期。
en_definition: $\mathcal E_c$: cleaning segments of chamber $c$, indexed by $e$; $\mathcal V_c$: its production tasks, indexed by $v$, each a $4\times1$ batch or $2\times2$ production cycle.

cn_definition: $\mathcal J_c^D$为分配至腔室$c$的辅助晶圆借用需求集合，$j=(p,r)$表示对$p$第$r$个成员位的需求，上标D表示辅助需求；$\mathcal T_c$为该腔可访问的实体辅助晶圆集合，$\tau$为实体编号。
en_definition: $\mathcal J_c^D$: auxiliary-loan requests assigned to chamber $c$; $j=(p,r)$ identifies pair $p$ and member position $r$ (D labels auxiliary demand). $\mathcal T_c$: accessible physical auxiliary identities, indexed by $\tau$.

cn_definition: 共享物理资源集合，$r$为资源编号，涵盖机械手执行机构、承片手、模块槽位、腔室及实体辅助晶圆。
en_definition: $\mathcal R$: shared physical resources, indexed by $r$, including robot actuators, hands, module slots, chambers, and physical auxiliary wafers.

cn_definition: 资源占用任务$o$允许选择的物理单元集合，$\ell$为单元编号；VTR的$D_1,D_2$表示两只脏手，$C_1,C_2$表示两只洁净手，数字为同类手编号。
en_definition: $\Gamma_o$: physical units eligible for occupancy task $o$, indexed by $\ell$. VTR units $D_1,D_2$ are dirty hands and $C_1,C_2$ clean hands; digits distinguish hands of one class.

cn_definition: $\operatorname{in}(w,r)$、$\operatorname{out}(w,r)$分别给出晶圆$w$进入、离开受限区段$r$的动作编号，用于引用相应起止时刻。
en_definition: $\operatorname{in}(w,r),\operatorname{out}(w,r)$: action indices for wafer $w$ entering/leaving constrained region $r$, used to reference event times.

cn_definition: $\mathcal D_{\rm fix}$为第二阶段固定分量的索引集合（索引$d$）；$\mathcal Q^w$为等待项集合（索引$\alpha$，上标$w$为等待标签）；$\mathcal I_h$为同腔、同一$2\times2$链内连续三个生产周期的中心索引$(c,q)$集合。
en_definition: $\mathcal D_{\rm fix}$: fixed second-stage components, indexed by $d$; $\mathcal Q^w$: waiting items, indexed by $\alpha$ (w labels waiting); $\mathcal I_h$: central indices $(c,q)$ of three consecutive production cycles in one chamber and $2\times2$ chain.

cn_definition: $\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\lambda_3,\lambda_4$依次为总等待、最大单项等待、节拍变化、软等待超额的非负权重；数字下标表示目标项类别。
en_definition: $\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\lambda_3,\lambda_4$: weights on total waiting, maximum individual waiting, cadence variation, and soft-limit excess, respectively. Numeric subscripts identify objective terms.

cn_definition: $\bar\omega_\alpha$为等待项$\alpha$的软上限；$\varepsilon_C$为第二阶段产品完工时间上界的非负容差，下标C表示完工时间，单位均为s。
en_definition: $\bar\omega_\alpha$: soft upper limit of waiting item $\alpha$; $\varepsilon_C$: nonnegative second-stage makespan tolerance (C labels completion time), in seconds.

cn_definition: $a_{wpr}=1$表示产品$w$占对$p$的成员位$r\in\{0,1\}$；$v_p=1$表示启用该对。$d_{pr}=v_p-\sum_w a_{wpr}$表示该位置由辅助晶圆补齐，不是额外的成员选择。
en_definition: $a_{wpr}=1$: product $w$ occupies member position $r\in\{0,1\}$ of pair $p$; $v_p=1$: pair $p$ is active. Derived $d_{pr}=v_p-\sum_w a_{wpr}$ indicates auxiliary filling of that position.

cn_definition: $\mu_{pm}=1$表示对$p$采用加工类型$m$；$z_{pc}=1$表示对$p$分配至腔室$c$，否则为0；产品自身配方$m_w$为输入。
en_definition: $\mu_{pm}=1$: pair $p$ has operation type $m$; $z_{pc}=1$: it is assigned to chamber $c$, otherwise 0. Product recipe $m_w$ remains an input.

cn_definition: $B_p=1$表示对$p$至少含一片产品；$B_p^{\psi}=1$表示该对含采用$2\times2$工艺的产品，否则为0；上标$\psi$为工艺标签。
en_definition: $B_p=1$: pair $p$ contains a product; $B_p^\psi=1$: it contains $2\times2$ products, otherwise 0. Superscript $\psi$ is a recipe label.

cn_definition: $K_{cqm}=1$表示腔室$c$周期$q$采用加工类型$m$；$X_{pcq}=1$表示对$p$参加该周期。$U_{cq}=\sum_mK_{cqm}\in\{0,1\}$为周期启用标记。
en_definition: $K_{cqm}=1$: cycle $q$ in chamber $c$ has type $m$; $X_{pcq}=1$: pair $p$ participates. Derived $U_{cq}=\sum_mK_{cqm}\in\{0,1\}$ indicates cycle activation.

cn_definition: $X^P_{pcq}=1$表示含产品对$p$参加腔室$c$的周期$q$，上标P表示产品；$A^{\psi}_{pcq},Z^{\psi}_{pcq}=1$分别表示该周期为$2\times2$含产品对$p$的首次、末次工艺处理，否则为0。
en_definition: $X^P_{pcq}=1$: product-containing pair $p$ occupies cycle $(c,q)$ (P labels products). $A^\psi_{pcq},Z^\psi_{pcq}=1$: its first/last exposure as a $2\times2$ product pair, respectively; otherwise 0.

cn_definition: $b_o=1$表示候选动作或资源占用任务$o$启用，$b_o=0$表示不启用；其取值由布局及可选搬运关系联结。
en_definition: $b_o=1$: candidate action or occupancy task $o$ is active, otherwise 0; activation is linked to layout and optional transfers.

cn_definition: 动作或资源占用任务$o$的开始、结束时刻（s）。固定时长动作的$e_o$由$s_o+d_ob_o$确定；占用区间端点由对应物理事件联结。
en_definition: $s_o,e_o$: start/end of action or occupancy task $o$, in seconds. For fixed-duration actions, $e_o=s_o+d_ob_o$; holding endpoints are linked to physical events.

cn_definition: $\gamma^{\rm early}_p=1$表示单源产品--辅助对$p$中辅助晶圆先行直接入锁；$\gamma^{\rm late}_p=1$表示产品放至AL后再取辅助晶圆；上标early、late标记两种入片方式，否则为0。
en_definition: $\gamma_p^{\rm early}=1$: single-source auxiliary wafer in product--auxiliary pair $p$ enters the lock first. $\gamma_p^{\rm late}=1$: it is picked up after product placement on AL. Superscripts label entry options; otherwise 0.

cn_definition: $A_{pcq}=1$表示周期$(c,q)$是对$p$在腔室$c$的首个参与周期；$Z_{pcq}=1$表示该周期是其末个参与周期，否则为0。
en_definition: $A_{pcq}=1$: cycle $(c,q)$ is the first occupied by pair $p$ in chamber $c$; $Z_{pcq}=1$: it is the last, otherwise 0.

cn_definition: $S_{cq},E_{cq}$为腔室$c$周期$q$的加工起止事件时刻（s）；$n_{cq}\in\{0,\ldots,H\}$为该周期结束后的累计生产周期数，清洁后归零。
en_definition: $S_{cq},E_{cq}$: start/end event times of chamber cycle $(c,q)$, in seconds. $n_{cq}\in\{0,\ldots,H\}$: cumulative production count after that cycle, reset by cleaning.

cn_definition: $f_{pcq}=1$表示对$p$位于腔室$c$周期$q$的访问前侧。$\kappa_{cq}=\sum_p(X_{pcq}-A_{pcq})$标记保留上一周期的一个对；$\upsilon_{cq}=U_{cq}-\sum_p(X_{pcq}-Z_{pcq})$标记本周期后全部退出，二者由占位及首末周期标记确定。
en_definition: $f_{pcq}=1$: pair $p$ occupies the accessible front side in cycle $(c,q)$. Derived $\kappa_{cq}=\sum_p(X_{pcq}-A_{pcq})$ marks one retained pair; $\upsilon_{cq}=U_{cq}-\sum_p(X_{pcq}-Z_{pcq})$ marks complete departure after the cycle.

cn_definition: $a_{vce}=1$表示生产任务$v$属于腔室$c$的清洁区段$e$；$q^{\rm cl}_{ce}=1$表示该段后有清洁。二者由周期序列联结，用于表达清洁动作窗口；此处$q^{\rm cl}$是标记名，不是周期索引。
en_definition: $a_{vce}=1$: production task $v$ belongs to segment $e$ of chamber $c$; $q^{\rm cl}_{ce}=1$: cleaning follows that segment. Both link to the cycle sequence; $q^{\rm cl}$ is an indicator name, not a cycle index.

cn_definition: $g_{j\tau}=1$表示借用需求$j=(p,r)$使用实体辅助晶圆$\tau$，否则为0；需求编号与实体编号分别表示一次使用任务和一片可复用晶圆。
en_definition: $g_{j\tau}=1$: loan request $j=(p,r)$ uses physical auxiliary wafer $\tau$, otherwise 0. Request and identity indices distinguish one use from one reusable wafer.

cn_definition: $h_{o\ell}=1$表示占用任务$o$选择单元$\ell$，否则为0；$\gamma_{pa}=1$表示对$p$在允许的同地点原子搬运段$a$上同步搬运。特殊下标$a=\mathrm{in}$时表示单源产品--辅助对随行入片选择。
en_definition: $h_{o\ell}=1$: task $o$ selects physical unit $\ell$; $\gamma_{pa}=1$: pair $p$ is transferred synchronously on eligible atomic leg $a$ at a common location. Special $a=\mathrm{in}$ denotes single-source accompanying entry.

cn_definition: 当动作$o,o^{\prime}$争用资源$r$的同一单元时，$y^r_{oo^{\prime}}=1$表示$o$先于$o^{\prime}$，取0表示反向次序；上标$r$标识资源，撇号区分两个动作。
en_definition: For tasks $o,o^{\prime}$ sharing a unit of resource $r$, $y^r_{oo^{\prime}}=1$ selects $o$ before $o^{\prime}$; 0 selects the reverse. Superscript $r$ identifies the resource; the prime distinguishes tasks.

cn_definition: 所有产品$w$回到原LP的时刻$e_{w,\mathrm{return}}$的共同上界（s）；第一阶段最小化该上界，return、max为语义标签。
en_definition: $C_{\max}$: common upper bound on all product-return times $e_{w,\mathrm{return}}$, in seconds, minimized in stage one. The labels return and max are semantic.

cn_definition: $\omega_\alpha$为等待项$\alpha$中对应事件间隔扣除必要时长后的非负余量（s），由事件时刻计算；$L_{\max}$为所有单项等待的共同上界（s）。
en_definition: $\omega_\alpha$: nonnegative event-time gap minus necessary duration for waiting item $\alpha$; $L_{\max}$: common upper bound on all individual waits, in seconds.

cn_definition: 腔室$c$内以周期$q$为中心的连续三个生产周期的节拍变化上界（s），即$|S_{c,q+1}-2S_{cq}+S_{c,q-1}|$的上界；仅对$(c,q)\in\mathcal I_h$定义。
en_definition: $v_{cq}$: upper bound on cadence variation $|S_{c,q+1}-2S_{cq}+S_{c,q-1}|$, in seconds, for three consecutive production cycles centered at $q$ in chamber $c$; defined only for $(c,q)\in\mathcal I_h$.

cn_definition: 等待项$\alpha$超出软上限$\bar\omega_\alpha$的非负超额上界（s），满足$\eta_\alpha\ge\max\{0,\omega_\alpha-\bar\omega_\alpha\}$。
en_definition: $\eta_\alpha$: upper bound on waiting above soft limit $\bar\omega_\alpha$, in seconds; $\eta_\alpha\ge\max\{0,\omega_\alpha-\bar\omega_\alpha\}$.
